title: Explain a decision you made
description: Justify a recent choice and say what you would have done if it had not worked.

brief.scene: You are in a one-to-one conversation. You have been asked to justify a choice you made recently: a tool, an approach, or a plan.
brief.yourGoal: State the decision, give your reasons as a trade-off, and answer the challenge.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Ask the person to pick one recent decision, such as a tool, an approach or a plan, and explain what they chose and why. One or two sentences only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Challenge the person by asking what they would have done if their choice had not worked. Refer to it only as that choice. One question only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Reasoning as a trade-off
judged.criterion: The reasoning is stated as a trade-off: the speaker names what they gave up or what the alternatives were, not just an assertion that the choice was good. The answer to the challenge names a concrete fallback.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Finish between 45 seconds and 2 min 50 sec
Give your reasoning as a trade-off, and name a fallback when challenged
